relations.name: U-P-U
relations.description: Users reviewing at least one same product
relations.notes: Low label similarity (0.167) despite feature similarity (0.711). Strong camouflage effect — fraudsters target same products as legitimate users.

relations.name: U-S-U
relations.description: Users having at least one same star rating within a week
relations.notes: Weak relation — same star ratings are common and provide limited discriminative signal for fraud.

relations.name: U-V-U
relations.description: Users with top-5% mutual review text TF-IDF similarity
relations.notes: Text similarity captures copy-paste fraud patterns. Moderate camouflage risk as sophisticated fraudsters vary their text.
